remarks: Welcome to 30 Dora Street unit 2, ideally located in Stamford's highly desirable Cove neighborhood. Enjoy the best of coastal living just minutes from the beach, waterfront parks, public transportation, I-95, and Metro-North. This spacious apartment features four bedrooms and two full bathrooms, offering plenty of room for comfortable living.  In addition to its four bedrooms and two full bathrooms, the home features a versatile additional space offering endless possibilities. Create the perfect entertainment room, home gym, playroom, home office, or additional living space. This flexible area adds valuable extra square footage and can easily adapt to your lifestyle needs.  The property includes off-street parking for two vehicles, along with access to the neighborhood's residential street parking permit program for additional parking flexibility. Best of all, all utilities are included in the rent, providing a truly hassle-free living experience. Whether you're commuting, enjoying a walk by the water, or simply relaxing at home, this location offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle.
